'''March 2001 Hastings tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Hastings, Minnesota on 17 March 2001. [[Graham Neal]] won it. It is known from Garrett Larson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1910">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-18-hastings-mn-deadbidy-style-3-17d1910/ hastings-mn-deadbidy-style-3-17], DeckTech (garrett "deadbody" larson, 18 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-18-hastings-mn-deadbidy-style-3-17d1910/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Hastings, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Graham Neal]]
